Container.Name: issuarr
Container.Overview:
Issuarr automatically finds, downloads, renames, tags and organizes your comic books (cbz and cbr) from Usenet, torrents and GetComics. It is a free, open-source successor to Mylar3 and a drop-in replacement for the linuxserver/mylar3 image: point Appdata at your old mylar3 folder and your settings and database carry over.
For the best database performance keep Appdata on a pool or disk path (for example /mnt/cache/appdata/issuarr) rather than /mnt/user, unless the appdata share is exclusive to a pool. See https://issuarr.github.io/issuarr/UNRAID/
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mylar mylar3 kapowarr comics comic manga cbz cbr comicvine getcomics
Container.Requires: A ComicVine API key (free, from comicvine.gamespot.com) and at least one download source: a Usenet indexer and client, a torrent client, or GetComics.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Issuarr web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, database and cover cache (kept in the mylar subfolder). Coming from Mylar3, use your old mylar3 appdata folder. A pool or disk path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/issuarr lets the database use its faster WAL mode.

Config.Name: Comics
Config.Description: Your comic library. Set Settings > General > Comic folder to /comics. Coming from Mylar3, keep the same container path as before.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: The folder where your download clients put finished downloads. Use the same container path your download client uses.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns your files (99 is nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns your files (100 is users on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for new files.
